aspects.label: Decision (the sharp DEWY-D question and its bearing)
aspects.source_of_truth: Receipt D-block columns written by src/app/api/compass/route.ts lines 439 to 476 (decision, trueNorth, whyBullets, mode, doorClass, atgTributaries, rawResponse) plus lineage columns (sessionId, parentId, version). Columns sharpQuestion, dewyVector, receiptId, sessionTs are declared in prisma/schema.prisma but never written by the route (0 of 267 by code path, custody: grep of route.ts).

cells.label: Question (sharp DEWY-D)

level_rule.L0: Receipt.decision empty (cannot occur: column is required and the route clamps the user question into it)
level_rule.L1: Receipt.decision present but only the raw user text (no coherencePct, no clarity lens): the sharpening is inferred
level_rule.L2: Receipt.decision present and Receipt.coherencePct non-null (the model stated how well-formed the question is)
level_rule.L3: Receipt.sharpQuestion or Receipt.dewyVector.D non-null (the question decomposed into the schema-canonical atomic form)
level_rule.L4: Brief.situationFraming exists for this receiptId and restates the same decision (second model call, brief route, semi-independent of the compass call)
level_rule.L5: Outcome.what exists for this receiptId and names the same decision

cells.tilde_when: L3 is tilde on every receipt today: sharpQuestion and dewyVector are never written by the compass route. L4 tilde when no Brief row.
cells.coverage_now: L2: 267 (decision required; coherencePct presence not measured this session, ~267 since the contract requires it). L3: 0 by code path. L4: 176 briefs. L5: 3 outcomes.

cells.label: Bearing (true_north plus why)

level_rule.L1: trueNorth present, whyBullets parses to an empty array
level_rule.L2: trueNorth present and whyBullets has at least one bullet
level_rule.L3: whyBullets has 2 or more bullets AND nciSelfGrade.action is true (the bearing decomposed into reasons and self-graded as one concrete step)
level_rule.L4: rawResponse.reasoning.paths contains a path with status 'selected' whose tag is 'True North' and whose title agrees with trueNorth (the paths block is a separate section of the same response: weakly independent, say so when scoring)
level_rule.L5: Outcome.matched is true for this receiptId

cells.tilde_when: nciSelfGrade null (pre-self-grade receipts) caps the cell at L2. No Outcome row caps at L4.
cells.coverage_now: L2: ~267 (contract requires 1 to 3 why bullets; array length not measured). L3: not measured (nciSelfGrade presence unknown). L4: not measured. L5: 2 (outcomes_matched).

cells.label: Tributaries (ATG: meta, challenge, adjacent)

level_rule.L1: atgTributaries parses but has fewer than 3 entries or entries lack a type
level_rule.L2: atgTributaries has exactly 3 entries with prompts
level_rule.L3: the 3 entries carry the typed triple meta / challenge / adjacent with non-empty prompts
level_rule.L4: a child Receipt exists whose parentId is this receipt AND whose parentTributaryIndex is 0, 1 or 2 (the follow-up actually taken confirms the tributary)
level_rule.L5: not applicable: no Outcome field bears on which tributary was taken; stays L4 max

cells.tilde_when: L4 is tilde on every receipt today: parentTributaryIndex_set is 0 although 107 children exist (the child path never writes the index).
cells.coverage_now: L2 to L3: ~267 (contract requires exactly 3 typed tributaries; not measured). L4: 0 (parentTributaryIndex_set 0). L5: 0 by definition.

cells.label: Mode and door (QUICKMOVE / PLAN / COURT, ONE_WAY / TWO_WAY)

level_rule.L1: mode present but doorClass null
level_rule.L2: mode and doorClass both present (both are derived by rule in route.ts selectMode and doorClass from horizon plus stakes)
level_rule.L3: rawResponse.reasoning.geometry.mode_trigger non-empty (the trigger named, e.g. 'HIGH stakes + ONE_WAY door')
level_rule.L4: rawResponse.decision_mode equals Receipt.mode AND rawResponse.door_class equals Receipt.doorClass (the model's own read agrees with the rule-derived stored value: genuinely independent sources)
level_rule.L5: Outcome row exists and regretScore <= 2 on a ONE_WAY receipt, or any Outcome on TWO_WAY (the door held)

cells.tilde_when: geometry missing (1 of 267) caps at L2. Disagreement at L4 is not tilde: it is a scored mismatch and should be surfaced (the Y-gate dim 12 reads the model's decision_mode, not the stored mode).
cells.coverage_now: L2: 267 (TWO_WAY 171 + ONE_WAY 96). L3: ~266 (geometry present on 266; mode_trigger presence not measured). L4: not measured. L5: 3.

cells.label: Lineage (seed, child, fork, baton)

level_rule.L2: child receipt: parentId non-null and version >= 1 (the thread position is stated)

level_rule.L5: Outcome row exists on this receipt or on its batonId successor

aspects.label: Risk / Ruin (gauntlet family: BAR, LAB, COURT, KKL, Funhouse)

Receipt.loki and Receipt.bar are declared in the schema and never written (0 of 267 by code path). Y-gate dims 2 (court) and 9 (ruin language in fated) in src/lib/ygate.ts are the code's own ruin detectors.

cells.label: Threat vectors (LAB: Loki objection, counter, Bayesian risk)

level_rule.L2: loki_challenge non-empty (the strongest objection stated)

cells.label: Ruin and reversibility (BAR)

aspects.label: Horizon as altitude ladder (Executive, Strategic, Operational, Tactical, Surgical; 2026-06-23 bar, matching the lattice zoom levels EXEC to SURGICAL)
aspects.source_of_truth: rawResponse.reasoning.geometry.altitude, free text like 'L2-L3 (Strategic-Operational)', ranges L0 to L4 (266 of 267 have geometry). Parse: regex L(\d)(?:\s*(?:-|to)\s*L?(\d))? gives lo and hi (hi defaults to lo), clamp 0 to 4; parenthetical \(([^)]+)\) split on '-' or '/' gives named rungs. Rung map (~ assessed from the two contract sample strings 'L1-L2 (Operational)' and 'L2-L3 (Strategic-Operational)'; no code constant maps L-numbers to rungs): L4 Executive, L3 Strategic, L2 Operational, L1 Tactical, L0 Surgical. GALACTIC and QUANTUM zoom levels sit outside the 0 to 4 range and are never emitted. ADR-041's economics (time, capital, opportunity cost, leverage, reward) become the L3 sub-fields per rung.

level_rule.L2: parsed altitude range covers L4
level_rule.L3: L2 plus the parenthetical names Executive AND the capital sub-field is present (stakes HIGH or protecting non-empty)
level_rule.L4: L2 plus mode is COURT and horizon is QUARTER or YEARS (the rule-derived mode and the user-picked horizon agree with the model's altitude)
level_rule.L5: Outcome.regretScore exists on this receipt

drift_notes: C aspect naming: ADR-041 says Clarity, Confidence, Coherence, Cohesion, Conviction; shipped nci_by_lens (route.ts contract and the clamp at line 449) says clarity, conviction, coherence, consequence, cadence. Code wins. Confidence survives only as PrepSession.confidence (used here as the L4 cross-confirm for C2); Cohesion has no field anywhere and is unmappable.

H aspect: ADR-041 defines H as economics (time, capital, opportunity cost, leverage, reward); the 2026-06-23 S-tier plan (_PATTERNS/2026-06-23-s-tier-execution-plan.md) uses 5H as the altitude ladder Executive / Strategic / Operational / Tactical / Surgical, and the task directs the ladder for the cells. Resolution here: cells are the five rungs, the economics become each rung's L3 sub-field. No code constant maps geometry.altitude L-numbers to rungs (grep of src for EXEC / STRATEGIC / SURGICAL constants returned nothing); the L4 Executive down to L0 Surgical map is assessed (~) from the two contract sample strings. The knowledge lattice's GALACTIC and QUANTUM levels are outside the L0 to L4 range the contract emits and are tilde by construction.

shape_vector_spec: Per receipt, score the 25 cells to a level 0 to 5 using the cell rules above (L0 = tilde). Collapse each aspect to one level in 1 to 5: take the non-tilde cells of the aspect; if the aspect is tilde-heavy (3 or more of its 5 cells at L0) its level is 1 (the floor), regardless of the other cells; otherwise its level is the median of the non-tilde cell levels, and with an even count take the lower middle value (GAAP-conservative, never rounds up). The result is a 5-digit code ordered D R W C H, e.g. 2 2 2 1 1, one point in the 5^5 = 3125-cell space. Caveat for H: the rung cells are structurally sparse (a receipt occupies 1 or 2 rungs, so H is tilde-heavy unless the L1 band inference fills 2 more rungs) and the digit records evidence depth, not position; carry the occupied rung set (e.g. {Operational, Strategic}) as a side label next to the code, not inside it. Expected corpus shape today (~ assessed from the coverage column, not computed): D ~2 (D3 and D5 cap at 2 or lower), R ~2, W ~2 to 3, C 1 on ~240 and 2 on 27, H 1 on most. Parses used by the collapse: kairos first token (upper-case, leading run of letters and slashes before the first space or dash, N/A is tilde, token outside the eleven known values is L1); altitude L-range (regex L(\d)(?:\s*(?:-|to)\s*L?(\d))?, hi defaults to lo, clamp 0 to 4, rung map L4 Executive to L0 Surgical, parenthetical names split on dash or slash); reversibility leading float (regex ^\s*(\d+(?:\.\d+)?), expected 0.05 to 1.0, higher = harder to reverse per the single contract sample, so the direction is ~ until sampled). Tool shape: each of the catalogued tools gets the same 5-digit code, authored from its JTBD string as the MINIMUM evidence level per aspect it needs to do its job honestly (a brief renderer needs D>=2 W>=2; the Accountant needs C>=2 and an L5 somewhere; an observatory replay needs D5 lineage >= 2 so W5 >= 2), plus two flags: gauntlet (true for tools in the BAR LAB COURT KKL Funhouse family, i.e. tools whose job is to handle ruin or a court BLOCK) and rungs (the H rung set the tool operates at, matched against the receipt's side label). Energy between receipt shape r and tool shape t: E(r, t) = sum over aspects a of w_a * |r_a - t_a|, a weighted L1 distance; default weights (~ assessed, tunable) w_D 1.0, w_R 1.5, w_W 1.0, w_C 1.0, w_H 0.5. Impedance: if the receipt carries a ruin or court BLOCK cell (any rawResponse.reasoning.court[].verdict == BLOCK, or yConditions contains dim 2 RED or dim 9 RED, or flowTopology == CLIFF) and the tool's gauntlet flag is false, E = infinity (the tool is not allowed to act on a free-solo receipt); gauntlet tools pay the ordinary distance. Rung mismatch adds w_H per rung of separation between the receipt's highest occupied rung and the tool's nearest rung (position penalty, since the H digit alone cannot carry it). A receipt matches a tool when E is finite and minimal over the catalog; ties break toward the tool with the lower sum of minimum levels (the cheaper instrument). Every number produced by this spec on the current corpus is non-GAAP (~) until the per-cell counts marked 'not measured' are run as SQL over the 267 rows.
